spokenMeaning: Every time you bend your answer to make everyone happy, you get more tired — and the energy never comes back.
viewerTakeaway: Three yeses tilt your answer line off its original heading, and the gold angle gap only widens — it never re-levels.
visualMechanism: bearing drift: each YES tilts the answer line off its heading

visualNarrative.action: Headline 'TRYING TO PLEASE EVERYONE TIRES YOU' reveals word-by-word on the left; on the right a gold hairline labelled ORIGINAL ANSWER fades in level, with a pivot dot at its left end.
visualNarrative.meaning: Names the cost, then fixes the heading you started from.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Left text block at 8% margins, gauge on the right 46%; gold hairline horizontal at 48% height, label secondary #B5B1A7 with 24px clearance.

visualNarrative.action: A white answer line draws out from the pivot, sitting just under and parallel to the hairline — your answer at its true heading.
visualNarrative.meaning: The unbent answer exists at full strength, so later drift is measurable.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Answer line 8px below the gold hairline, parallel, small neutral tick at its tip; no text overlaps anywhere.

visualNarrative.action: The first 'YES' badge lands at the line's tip; the line rotates down about 12° and holds there, the badge staying attached.
visualNarrative.meaning: First compliance is a deliberate turn away — paid, not bounced back.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Badge label in secondary #B5B1A7, one small gold arc opens between hairline and line, rigid line, no elastic overshoot.

visualNarrative.action: A second 'YES' badge joins at mid-line; the line rotates further down while the first angle and badge keep their exact positions.
visualNarrative.meaning: Repetition adds drift instead of returning it — fatigue accumulates.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Total tilt now visibly below the untouched hairline, both badges riding the same rigid line, single gold accent.

visualNarrative.action: The third 'YES' badge lands; the whole line sits far off heading while the gold hairline never moves.
visualNarrative.meaning: Quiet resentment: exhaustion reads as posture, not alarm.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Three equal secondary badges on one angled line, hairline fixed and clean, no warning color anywhere.

visualNarrative.action: A gold angle-arc measures hairline-to-line divergence, the word TIRES shifts gold, caption 'IT NEVER COMES BACK' fades top-right; frame settles.
visualNarrative.meaning: The residue is a permanent deficit — the heading does not reset on its own.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Static frame: one gold hairline, one gold arc, one gold headline word; caption in the top band, clear of subtitles.

compositionIntent: Left text, right object: headline block left-aligned at 8% margin in the top 60% of the left 44%, caption on that same band; pivot and gauge occupy the right 46% with the hairline at 48% height, leaving a blank line under the headline block. Bottom 18% reserved for subtitles; ~62% negative space; gold only on hairline, arc and the word TIRES, all YES labels secondary.
visualEvidence: Answer line tilts ever further below the untouched gold ORIGINAL ANSWER hairline.
Each turn appears only when its YES badge lands — the line is rigid, so drift accumulates straight to angled.
Earlier badges keep their exact positions as later ones arrive; no cost is ever recovered.
Gold angle-arc quantifies the divergence near the pivot; no text collisions, caption in the top band.
One gold headline word, one gold hairline, one gold arc; three secondary YES badges; seven elements, single accent.
forbiddenInterpretations: A person, figure, or slumped character — the line, badges and arc carry the fatigue.
A vessel, liquid level, battery, or percentage progress bar — that repeats the prior depletion device.
A sagging rope, spring, elastic bounce, or wobble — the line rotates rigidly and never springs back.
Gold YES labels or teal as a second accent; two accent words maximum in the frame.
Overlapping or struck-through text, caption inside the subtitle band, camera zoom, shake, or glow.
noveltyIntent: Fatigue is measured as permanent angular drift of a rigid answer line: every YES stays physically on the frame as a badge that turns the line off its gold original heading, and the arc gap never re-levels — no vessel, bar, grid, loop, sagging rope, or bounce as in prior projects.
